images.title: Bloodborne World Map (all areas incl. The Old Hunters)
images.description: Full connected world map of every area including The Old Hunters DLC (Hunter's Nightmare, Research Hall, Fishing Hamlet), with lamps and boss lamps marked and area labels, on a dark background. Downscaled from the 9000x10000 original.
images.credit: u/Dibilowas (Reddit, Nov 2025); author says it was traced over area maps from the official strategy guide
images.license: game-derived fan image from Reddit, no license stated

images.title: Bloodborne World Map: Lanterns of the Dreaming World
images.description: Classic colour-coded world map of Yharnam and the Nightmares with every lamp labelled by name (base game; does not include The Old Hunters areas).
images.credit: Hypn0tyk (u/Hypnotyks, @Hypn0tyk); also hosted on https://bloodborne.wiki.fextralife.com/Overall_World_Maps
images.license: game-derived fan image from Reddit/imgur (mirrored on Fextralife), no license stated

images.title: Bloodborne Perspective World Map
images.description: Side-on perspective view of how the areas stack and connect vertically.
images.credit: Ultima (via Fextralife Bloodborne Wiki)
images.license: game-derived image from Fextralife, no license stated
